# Support

- Usage questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/glincker/stacklit/discussions).
- Bugs and feature requests: [open an issue](https://github.com/glincker/stacklit/issues/new/choose) with the command, its output and the language of the repo.
- Security reports: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not file them as public issues.
- Reference: [docs/USAGE.md](../docs/USAGE.md) and [docs/FAQ.md](../docs/FAQ.md).
